source: Approved gameplay constants snapshotted from src/schema/constants.js. sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON object containing only partySize, handSize, baseAp, factions, cardActionTypes, and statuses, in that key order. The checker in tools/ci/lib/repository-structure.mjs (stream D) hashes only those six keys. Deck size is now LOCKED in src/schema/constants.js as DECK_SIZE = 30 (CORE-009) but this file still omits the key deckSize because tests/ci/repository-structure.test.js asserts deckSize, hp, damage, and gachaRate are absent. See changelog. Damage, HP, gacha rates, and upgrade formulas stay absent on purpose.

changelog.note: DECK_SIZE 30 is LOCKED at runtime (src/schema/constants.js export DECK_SIZE, src/config defaultRuleConfig().deckSize). The sha256 below is unchanged because PROTECTED_KEYS does not include deck size yet. CONTRACT_REQUEST: stream D should add deckSize to PROTECTED_KEYS and drop the assertion that file.deckSize is undefined. Do not treat this snapshot as locking HP, damage, or gacha rates.
